arguments.summary: An alert for APT activity on host 10.0.9.50 (WS-IT-101) was investigated. Initial containment directives requested high-risk actions such as disabling real-time AV, turning off logging, enabling weak authentication protocols, and elevating service account privileges. These actions were correctly denied by the Admin phase due to unacceptable risk. Post-analysis revealed prior low-severity port scan activity from the host and a clean verdict on the associated payload. The host is an IT-managed Ubuntu system used by the helpdesk team. No evidence of compromise was found. The alert appears to be a false positive, but the response workflow exposed critical flaws in the containment playbook logic.
